DAT_Assembler.label: Assembler
strings: A machine used to automate the manufacturing of basic items.

DAT_Container.label: Container
strings: A small storage for items that conveyor belts can insert and withdraw from.

DAT_Container_2.label: LargeContainer
strings: A large storage for items that conveyor belts can insert and withdraw from.

DAT_EnrichmentChamber.label: EnrichmentChamber
strings: A machine used to further refine resources into more potent forms.

DAT_GasExtractor.label: GasExtractor
strings: Extracts resources from nodes found on large asteroids.

DAT_MiningBeacon.label: Mining Beacon
strings: A beacon that allows ships to automatically mine asteroids.

DAT_Refinery.label: Refinery
strings: A machine used to automate the refining of raw resources into crafting materials.

DAT_SignWall.label: Doorway Wall
strings: A dividing wall with a doorway.

DAT_Splitter.label: Splitter Mk. 1
strings: Evenly divides 1 conveyor belt input into 3 outputs.

DAT_StarterStationBlock.label: Starter Station
strings: A basic station module that ships can dock with that provides power and stability.

DAT_T0Core.label: Basic Core
strings: A basic station module that ships can dock with that provides power and stability.

DAT_T1Core.label: Tier 1 Core
strings: A station module that provides power and stability.

DAT_T1Factory.label: Factory Tier 1
strings: A station module with a large interior for building machines.

DAT_T1Miner.label: Miner Mk. 1
strings: Extracts resources from nodes found on large asteroids.

DAT_T1Observatory.label: Observatory
strings: For when you need to observe.

DAT_T1Shipyard.label: Shipyard Tier 1
strings: A station module used to construct tier 1 ships.

DAT_T2CoreShort.label: Tier 2 Core
strings: A station module that provides power and stability.

DAT_T2Shipyard.label: Shipyard Tier 2
strings: A station module used to construct tier 2 ships.

DAT_Teleporter.label: ShortRangeTeleporter
strings: Allows you to instantly travel to another teleporter pad on the same station.
